name: Máriapócs (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:6:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Máriapócs: a blue shield with a yellow twin-towered church, a quill and ears of grain.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
